title: Application-level lint rules
summary: Whole-program lint rules: TLS checks off, UI calls in console/service apps, DUnitX tests without asserts, weak ciphers, asm without Win64, GUI WriteLn
intro: Read this to see what each application-level rule reports, which ship ON or OFF, and how the checks avoid the common false positives (writeln-in-gui-app asks the program: a console .dpr / .dproj reports nothing).
